root_cause.text: The `batadv_gw_node_free` function in the batman-adv subsystem fails to clear the currently selected gateway pointer (`bat_priv->gw.curr_gw`) and release its reference during mesh teardown, leaving a stale gateway state.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `batadv_gw_node_free` is updated to set `bat_priv->gw.curr_gw` to `NULL` using `rcu_replace_pointer` and decrement its reference count with `batadv_gw_node_put` before freeing the gateway list.

intent_record.how: This ensures that the reference to the currently active gateway node is safely cleared and its reference count is decremented during the gateway cleanup process, preventing a reference leak.

commit bd3524c14bd02f94a4fa33e700883e01182f5ed5
Author: Simon Wunderlich <sw@simonwunderlich.de>
Date:   Mon Aug 3 19:13:58 2015 +0200

    batman-adv: remove obsolete deleted attribute for gateway node
    
    With rcu, the gateway node deleted attribute is not needed anymore. In
    fact, it may delay the free of the gateway node and its referenced
    structures. Therefore remove it altogether and simplify purging as well.
    
    Signed-off-by: Simon Wunderlich <simon@open-mesh.com>
